newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH EXPORT CREDIT Q1 PROFIT UP TO FIM 93 MLN.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH EXPORT CREDIT Q1 PROFIT UP TO FIM 93 MLN.

text.p: Finnish state-owned financing company Finnish Export Credit said in a statement on Monday its first-quarter operating profit exceeded budget and more than doubled on the year-ago period to 93 million markka.
The operating profit for the same period a year ago was 39.6 million markka.
The company said the increase was primarily due to growth in net investment gains. It booked net investment gains of 39 million markka against a 28 million loss in the same period a year ago.
FEC president Antti Lehtinen said in the statement that demand for credit, notably for projects in countries in the Far East, had remained strong.
